description: Defines the 'Screen' entity class for ORM mapping, representing a screen in the HRM system with properties like id, name, action URL, associated module, menu configuration, and permissions.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: Entity class representing a UI screen with properties for id, name, URL, module, menu configuration, and permissions, mapped to the 'ohrm_screen' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the screen.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the screen.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the screen.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the screen.

methods.name: getActionUrl
methods.description: Returns the action URL associated with the screen.

methods.name: setActionUrl
methods.description: Sets the action URL for the screen.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with the screen.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Associates a module with the screen.

methods.name: getMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Returns the menu configurator string, if any.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Returns the collection of permissions for the screen.

methods.name: setScreenPermissions
methods.description: Sets the collection of permissions for the screen.
